text_block_list.text:
I spotted Manhattan Cafe on the rooftop,
having a conversation all by herself with "someone."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Is it because I've run so many races... Maybe that's it...
Somehow, my body feels... so heavy...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“...That might be true, too...
...I just feel so completely worn out...”

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I closed my eyes in bed, and it was already morning...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ah... And yet, I want to dream again...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Diving into a sea of stars...
I just want to slowly... sink in silence...

She seems tired. Running in consecutive
races might be the cause.
It would be wise to reconsider her schedule.
